items.title: President Donald Trump shares speech at rescheduled ... - YouTube
items.summary: Ladies and gentlemen, please join me in welcoming the 45th and 47th president of the United States, President Donald J. Trump. And I'm proud to be an American where at least I [music] know I'm free. And I won't forget the men who died, who gave that [music] life to me. And I [singing] gladly stand up next to you [music] and remember still today. Cuz there ain't [music and singing] no doubt I love this land. God bless the USA. Wow, that was very beautiful. But this has not been an easy evening. [...] I would never call anybody fat. I have my own problems, you know. It's not like I'm perfect. Sir, in the back, don't call him a fat pig. Okay, that's I'm sticking up for him. Don't call him you. You can't do that, sir. You can't call JB Pritsker a fat pig, please. All right. Thank you very much. I appreciate it. Everyone's trying to figure out who is that guy. Does he exist? But the nice part is when you do that, the press can't get you because I'm defending a man who obviously has a problem. [...] great people. And you know, I used an expression and I've used it right from the beginning. I did this for one reason, to make America great again. And that's what's happening right before your very eyes. We have made America great again. It's going to get a lot greater. So, thank you all very much. It's an honor to be with you. Thank you. Thank you very much. [applause] There's no need to feel down. I say nothing on the ground. I say you're in a new town. There's no need to be.

items.title: US President Donald Trump hosts Israeli Prime Minister ...
items.summary:
### Description
21511 views
Posted: 28 Jul 2026
Israel's Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has met with President Donald Trump in Washington DC for their first in-person talks since US airstrikes on Iran began in February.
 
The meeting comes amid signs of growing friction between the two leaders. Trump has publicly criticised Israel for continuing strikes in Lebanon and ignoring a ceasefire. [...] a plan for shared control over the Strait of Hormuz. [music] And protesters clash with police in the city of Isfahan as Iran executes two men who took part in anti-government rallies earlier this year. Well, Donald Trump has hosted the Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at the White House for the first time since the two nations launched air strikes on Iran in late February triggering a 5-month conflict that has reshaped the Middle East forever. High on the agenda Tehran's nuclear [...] Tehran's nuclear program. Well, ahead of the meeting Mr. Trump told Fox News the US has had some very good talks with Iran. He said he wants to avoid targeting Iran's bridges and power plants if possible. It's a very very delicate balance. So I think we have a very strong position right now. They know I'm going to do that if they don't make a deal, he said. Well, the two sides have now paused strikes on each other for a fourth night as the US president said on Monday he was giving diplomacy

items.title: Watch: Trump delivers eulogy honouring Lindsey Graham
items.summary:
# Watch: Trump delivers eulogy honouring Lindsey Graham

US President Donald Trump delivered the eulogy honouring his close ally Lindsey Graham at the late senator's funeral. Fox News host Sean Hannity also gave remarks.

Trump hailed Graham as a "true American original" and "beloved friend" during the funeral service at Washington National Cathedral, which was attended by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukraine President Volodomyr Zelensky. [...] President Donald Trump wearing a blue suit and red tie, talks to reporters.

## Trump: 50% tariffs response to Canada's treatment of US farmers

This new round of duties on Canadian goods is fuelling speculation about a potential announcement of new US tariffs on countries across the world.

Two men in a boat reach over the side to grab a black dog swimming in the water.

## Watch rescuers save missing dog from San Francisco Bay [...] Six beluga whales have arrived in Illinois and Texas after being moved from a Canadian marine park that could no longer care for them.

A split screen of a man wearing an under armour t-shirt on the left and a woman wearing a yellow vest on the right

## 'It's frustrating' - Canadians react to new US tariffs

President Donald Trump has imposed a 50% tariff on a wide range of Canadian goods in retaliation for what he called "unequal treatment" of US products.

items.summary:

# WATCH: Trump pays tribute to Sen. Graham during National Cathedral funeral service

President Donald Trump paid tribute to the late Sen. Lindsay Graham, R-S.C., at a memorial service Tuesday at the Washington National Cathedral.

Watch the president's full remarks in the video player above. [...] "For more than 30 years, nothing of consequence happened in this capital without Lindsey Graham knowing about it. Nothing of significance happened anywhere in the world without Lindsey Graham having a view on it. And no bill became law in the most exceptional republic in human history without Lindsey Graham having a say in it," Trump said. "He was a man who gave America the full measure of his good and mighty heart until that heart itself just gave out."

## BBC outside court as judge rules singer D4vd will face murder trial

The body of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez was found last September inside the trunk of a Tesla registered to singer D4vd.

Man spraying an police officer in the face.
